segments.he: צְרִיכִין לִבְכּוֹת וּלְפָרֵשׁ שִׂיחָתוֹ אֵיזֶה שָׁעָה בַּיּוֹם וּשְׁאָר כָּל
segments.en: The very essence of the miracle of Purim came about through Mordechai — through the multitude of cries and outcries that he cried out to Hashem, and through which he drew Yisrael too into crying and calling out greatly to Hashem. For there is no counsel against them except through this — for our only strength is in the mouth. For they provoke Yisrael in many and various ways, seeking to bring into Yisrael, Heaven forbid, anger and fury within themselves — and through this they seek to seize the flow of abundance from Yisrael, Heaven forbid, and to overpower them. And therefore the only counsel and stratagem is to cry out greatly to Hashem and to pray and to implore Him — in the aspect of: "My heart was hot within me; as I mused, a fire blazed up; then I spoke with my tongue" [Tehillim 39:4] — meaning that one must convert the burning heat within the heart arising from the abundance of troubles — which seeks to bring one to anger, Heaven forbid — and convert it all into prayers and supplications and requests and outcries to Hashem with the warmth of the heart. "My heart was hot within me... I spoke with my tongue" — as above.

segments.he: בֶּאֱמֶת עַתָּה בַּגָּלוּת שֶׁנֶּחֱרָב הַבֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ קָשֶׁה מְאד לִשְׂמחַ כִּי אִם בְּכחַ הַצַּדִּיקִים שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהֶם דַּעַת גָּדוֹל וְנִפְלָא שֶׁנֶּחְשָׁב כְּבִנְיַן בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה כָּל מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ דֵּעָה וְכוּ'. שֶׁהֵם מַמְשִׁיכִים עָלֵינוּ שִׂמְחָה בּוֹ יִתְבָּרַךְ כְּדֵי שֶׁנּוּכַל לְהִתְקַיֵּם בַּגָּלוּת הַמַּר הַזֶּה.
segments.en: And this is the aspect of what is written at the opening of Torah teaching [Likutay Moharan 59] — that the primary rectification of the Heichal HaKodesh [Sanctuary] comes through mishpat [judgment], through judging oneself on every matter — meaning through secluding oneself and making a reckoning with one's soul, judging oneself, and pouring forth one's speech before Hashem with warmth of heart — until the fire of mishpat is aroused and burns away the evil of the souls that are being brought close, as discussed there.

segments.he: וְעַל כֵּן קָרְאָה לוֹ אִמּוֹ בֶּן אוֹנִי. כִּי רָחֵל מֵתָה אָז וְנִקְבְּרָה בְּפָרָשַׁת דְּרָכִים כְּדֵי שֶׁיּוּכְלוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִבְכּוֹת עַל קִבְרָהּ בְּעֵת הַחֻרְבָּן כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה. וְעַל כֵּן מֵחֲמַת שֶׁרָחֵל אִמֵּנוּ רָאֲתָה גּדֶל הַחֻרְבָּן שֶׁיִּהְיֶה קדֶם שֶׁנִּזְכֶּה לַקֵּץ הָאַחֲרוֹן. עַל כֵּן קָרְאָה שְׁמוֹ בֶּן אוֹנִי. עַל שֵׁם גּדֶל הָאֲנִינוּת וְהַבְּכִיָּה שֶׁצְּרִיכִין בְּכָל לַיְלָה לִבְכּוֹת עַל חֻרְבַּן בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ. וְכֵן צָרִיךְ כָּל אֶחָד לִצְעק וְלִבְכּוֹת הַרְבֵּה בְּכָל יוֹם עַל פְּגָמָיו שֶׁמְּעַכְּבִין בִּנְיַן בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת קוֹל בָּרָמָה נִשְׁמָע נְהִי בְּכִי תַּמְרוּרִים רָחֵל מְבַכָּה עַל בָּנֶיהָ וְכוּ'. אֲבָל אָבִיו קָרָא לוֹ בִּנְיָמִין עַל שֵׁם אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי יַעֲקב קָרָא אוֹתוֹ בֶּן יָמִין עַל שֵׁם הַסּוֹף שֶׁנַּחֲזר לְאֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל וְיִבָּנֶה בֵּית הַמִּקְדָּשׁ בְּחֶלְקוֹ שֶׁל בִּנְיָמִין שֶׁשָּׁם מְקוֹר הַשִּׂמְחָה.
segments.en: When one must pray or engage in the service of Hashem, one must have great holy boldness in every aspect — both toward people of the world, so as not to be embarrassed before the mockers, and not to be nullified, Heaven forbid, by the cynicism of the brazen ones of the generation. And even before Hashem Himself, one must have great boldness — for although certainly one must be ashamed before Hashem (as Rabbainu of blessed memory writes elsewhere in Likutay Moharan II:72), even so one must not remain in that shame, Heaven forbid. Rather one must strengthen and fortify oneself with great boldness and say: "Even though I am not worthy to pray before You, and who am I to merit to pray before You — even so, in Your great kindness I trust, that You hear the prayer of every mouth. And I make bold before You to request from You everything I need."

segments.he: הַיְנוּ שֶׁיַּעֲקב אָמַר שֶׁגַּם עַתָּה צְרִיכִין לִקְרוֹתוֹ בִּנְיָמִין עַל שֵׁם אֶרֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת שִׂמְחָה. כִּי גַּם עַתָּה בַּגָּלוּת אָסוּר לִהְיוֹת בְּעַצְבוּת רַק צְרִיכִין לִצְעק וְלִבְכּוֹת וּלְפָרֵשׁ שִׂיחָתוֹ אֵיזֶה שָׁעָה בַּיּוֹם. אֲבָל בְּכָל הַיּוֹם צְרִיכִים לִהְיוֹת בְּשִׂמְחָה לְשַׂמֵּחַ נַפְשׁוֹ בְּכָל דַּרְכֵי הָעֵצוֹת. כִּי עַל יְדֵי שִׂמְחָה עִקַּר הַבֵּרוּר מֵהֵיכְלֵי הַתְּמוּרוֹת שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה דַּיְקָא יוֹצְאִין מִן הַגָּלוּת כָּל אֶחָד לְפִי בְּחִינָתוֹ בִּבְחִינַת כִּי בְשִׂמְחָה תֵּצֵאוּ וְכַנַּ"ל. (שָׁם אוֹת מד):
segments.en: Truly, in holiness a person must be bold even before Hashem Himself — for although he knows what he has sinned and rebelled against Hashem, if afterward he is ashamed to ask Hashem to draw him close to His service, and is ashamed to engage in His service because of the multitude of his sins, this is not the shame of holiness. On the contrary, this is the very shame of the Sitra Achra, which weakens his resolve in order to distance him from Hashem entirely. For the primary shame of holiness must be before the sin — a great shame before Hashem as before flesh and blood literally — so that one not commit any transgression, and not do anything against His will.
